title: Response::builder().body().unwrap() in handlers
description: server.rs:19-23, api.rs:1105, discovery.rs:117,133-134,171,190. Multiple instances of HeaderValue::parse().unwrap() and Response::builder().body().unwrap() in network-reachable code. The security_headers middleware (server.rs:19-23) calls .parse().unwrap() on static strings which is safe but inconsistent with the project's no-unwrap policy. The discovery.rs instances at lines 117,133-134,171,190 build responses with .unwrap() — these won't fail in practice but establish a pattern contrary to the project's defensive standards.
